issues.description: Method return type mismatch for Farm.singFarmSong() and Farm.singFarmSongVerse(Animal): the problem UML (problem_statement.md) and the provided template (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) define/expect these methods to be void and to print the song (use System.out.println). In contrast, the solution implementation (src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java) defines singFarmSong() as returning String and singFarmSongVerse(Animal) as returning String and assembling/returning the song text. This discrepancy leaves students uncertain whether to implement printing (void) or returning a String, and may cause incompatibility with tests or grading that expect one API shape or the other.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the API consistent across artifacts. Preferred option A (align with UML/template): change the solution to match the problem/template by making singFarmSong() return void and singFarmSongVerse(Animal) return void (or be private void) and perform printing (System.out.println) directly. Update the solution implementation so singFarmSong() iterates animals and invokes the void verse printer for each. Alternative option B (if returning text is desired): update the UML and the template to specify singFarmSong(): String and singFarmSongVerse(Animal): String, and change the template signatures and problem text to describe/expect a returned String (and update tests accordingly). Choose one option and apply it consistently to problem statement, template, and solution so students have a single clear API to implement.
